## Lip Sync: MiniMax H3 Max

**Input Assets**
- [api_minimax_h3_max_lipsync_input.png](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/api_minimax_h3_max_lipsync_input.png) — required workflow input (`input/api_minimax_h3_max_lipsync_input.png`)
- [api_minimax_h3_max_lipsync_input.mp3](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/refs/heads/main/input/api_minimax_h3_max_lipsync_input.mp3) — required workflow input (`input/api_minimax_h3_max_lipsync_input.mp3`)

**Make a portrait talk to your audio track.** One image and one voice clip: the model renders the performance and matches the mouth to the recording, keeping the length of the audio.

---

### What this graph does

1. **Load Image**: the person to animate, at least 256 x 256 and an aspect ratio between 0.4 and 2.5.
2. **Load Audio**: the voice track, 5 to 899 seconds.
3. **MiniMax H3 Max Lip Sync**: renders the talking head. This node takes no prompt, the performance comes from the audio.
4. **Save Video**: writes `api_minimax_h3_max_lipsync.mp4`.

### Parameters

| Widget | What it does |
|---|---|
| `resolution` | `480P`, `768P`, `1080P` or `2K`; the aspect ratio snaps to the closest supported one for the image. |
| `transcription` | Transcribes the audio first and steers the mouth shapes with the text. Worth turning on for accented or noisy audio. |
| `seed` | Same seed gives similar, not identical, takes. |

### Measured on this graph

`api_minimax_h3_max_lipsync_input.png` with the 9.35 s voice-over produced a 768 x 1024 clip, 225 frames, 9.375 s at 24 fps. The length follows the audio, not a widget.

### Gotchas

- Audio must run 5 to 899 seconds; a short line is rejected, so pad the recording.
- The output length equals the audio length, so cut the picture to the voice.
- Keep the head and mouth inside the frame; a tight crop animates far better than a full body shot.
- Portraits under 256 px on a side fail validation before any render starts.
